previous_defects_corrected: Doca rotation controls clipped by host dimensions
Lastro accepted CSV maximum clipped in financial summary

manual_incomplete_review.interpretation: Incomplete checks remain inconclusive in the original axe output, accompanied by this separate manual review; they are not rewritten as automated passes.

doca.symbol_names: Visible rotation symbols match the Portuguese accessible functional names.
doca.rendered_regression: Actual computed contrast >=4.5; centre and four corner hit-tests; actual left/right rotations; all three engines.

lastro.method: sRGB alpha composition including the decorative stripe, channel linearization, relative luminance and (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05). Loaded data confirmed before axe.

manual_incomplete_review.limits: Source-color calculations and screenshot review do not establish blanket WCAG conformance; no manual screen-reader or voice-control session.
